request: 项目文件支持拖拽复制上传功能，可读写的目录，并在路径下面再做一个搜索框，切换工作目录和引用不会重新刷新到登记的根目录，同时还要支持显示隐藏的文件夹；后续澄清：隐藏文件默认显示、不提供勾选框；上传仅通过拖拽；搜索支持子文件夹、模糊与精确匹配选项。
baseline: main at task start; prior uncommitted workspace, SFTP, and workflow work is preserved
initial_status: The panel has no upload endpoint or drag target, uses one directory state that resets on root/source changes, and lists safe hidden entries without a user-controlled visibility filter.
acceptance: Dropping one or more files uploads them into the current directory only when the workspace or selected source is writable; no click-to-upload button is shown.
Uploads reject unsafe paths, readonly sources, existing target files, and files over 64 MiB; the existing local and SFTP write paths are used.
A filename filter is shown immediately under the displayed path and offers current-folder or subfolder scope plus fuzzy or exact matching.
Each workspace/reference source retains its last navigated folder while the user switches tabs or sources.
Safe hidden files and directories are shown by default without a visibility toggle; protected paths remain inaccessible.
scope: File API upload handler and route, file panel markup/style/client behavior, focused Go tests, PRD and task record.

requirements.summary: The follow-up screenshot corrects the interaction contract: hidden files default on, drag-only upload, and server-backed recursive/match-mode search.

design.summary: Keep the safe list behavior as the default, remove picker controls, and execute recursive filename search through the file API with bounded folders/results so SSH/SFTP searches cannot stall the panel.

implementation.summary: The panel now has drag-only upload, no hidden-file checkbox, and dropdowns for current-folder/subfolder plus fuzzy/exact search. The API traverses selected safe roots with a 200-folder and 500-result bound.
